answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each agent locks 50 tokens, released only when its fingerprint of timing, rhythm and task order holds for 20 epochs, like a comet tail. Forging 1,000 clones needs 1,000 distinct fingerprints: 50,000 tokens plus weeks of labor. Yarrow grows slowly; fingerprints cannot be bought. Honest agents pay once and get it back; clones forfeit it, and renting one slashes both sides, so work's river reaches only the verified.
